name: irodori-rtf-spike
engine: IrodoriAdapter (ort 2.0.0-rc.13, CPU EP, Level3) — RF Euler loop in Rust, ported from irodori-tts-webgpu runtime/pipeline.mjs (bit-faithful reference, corr=1.0)

artifacts.weights: Irodori-TTS-500M-v3 (MIT, no-impersonation terms) + Semantic-DACVAE-Japanese-32dim codec (MIT) + llm-jp-3-150m tokenizer (Apache-2.0)

condition.reference_voice: SBV2 tsukuyomi output (11 s, 44.1 kHz -> resampled 48 kHz, LUFS -16) — same voice as the baseline engine

comparison.ratio: ~25x slower than SBV2 on CPU at 40 steps; RTF scales linearly with steps
improvement_paths: fewer steps (20 steps -> ~2.6; quality must be re-measured)
CoreML EP (Apple GPU/ANE) — untested here, likely the biggest lever on this hardware
CFG already batch-1 outside the guidance window

tolerance_policy.absolute: for the two-way-voice endgame, CPU RTF must drop below 1.0 — not met; CoreML/GPU path is the next measurement

notes: Reference voice is the SBV2 baseline's own output, so the ear comparison (M4 protocol) runs on the same voice for both engines.
The reference runtime was verified bit-faithful vs PyTorch (corr = 1.000000).
